purpose: Teach: 原始/平面/増進/傷害/放火/脅し/蔓延/肝臓

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、原始反射と乳児の発達を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we're researching primitive reflexes and infant development as a medical team.
lines.style: Clear, clinical opener. Steady voice, professional but not distant. Direct eye contact. Measured pace establishing the scope of the work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、CT画像の平面解析を医療チームで学びます
lines.en: Yes, our team studies planar analysis of CT imaging together.
lines.style: Gentle confirmation. Slight warmth underneath the clinical language. A slight pause before 'planar' — choosing the word carefully. Encouraging tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地域の健康増進事業を、貴院、推進されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does advance community health initiatives, doesn't it, Doctor.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observant tone. Genuine curiosity mixed with respect. Soft attack on the opening. Not quite a question — more like thinking aloud in her presence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、傷害患者の救急対応を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, our team handles emergency response for assault patients.
lines.style: Even, clinical. No softening of the difficult subject matter. Factual delivery. A slight steadiness in the voice — this is important work she takes seriously.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 放火被害者の火傷治療を、貴院、進められてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does advance burn treatment for arson victims, doesn't it, Doctor.
lines.style: Careful, almost gentle observation. Acknowledging something difficult without flinching. Slower pace. Genuine respect underneath the formal structure.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者への脅し的説明は医療チームで避けます
lines.en: Yes, we make sure our team avoids frightening or threatening explanations to patients.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Each word carries weight. Not defensive — simply stating a value. Slight emphasis on 'avoid.' Humane without being sentimental.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感染症の院内蔓延防止を、貴院、徹底されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does maintain strict protocols for preventing hospital-acquired infections, doesn't it, Doctor.
lines.style: Genuinely impressed tone. Not flattery — real recognition of careful work. Slight rise at the end of the observation. Warm curiosity.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、肝臓移植のプログラムを医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Yes, we're advancing our liver transplant program as a team.
lines.style: Calm, measured. Pride in the work without overstatement. Warm but professional. Close, intimate delivery — speaking to someone she trusts. Slight softness at the close.
